{{Quote|Prepare a boarding party.|Darth Vader preparing to use TIE boarding crafts.|<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
The '''TIE boarding craft''' was a variant of [[Sienar Fleet Systems]]'s [[TIE series]]. An [[armor]]ed [[shuttle]], it was used by the [[Galactic Empire]] for troop [[transport]]ation and boarding.

==Characteristics==
[[File:TIEBoardingCraft-TFOWM.png|thumb|left|250px|Underside view of a TIE boarding craft]]
The design of the TIE boarding craft was modelled after the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber]],<ref name="SWE TCGSWG" /> Both [[TIE series]] [[starfighter]]s consisted of a pair of elongated pods positioned side-by-side between a pair of "bent" wings. However, with a length of 7.6 [[meter]]s, a width of 9.9, and a height of 5.9, it was slightly taller and wider than the TIE/sa bomber, but slightly shorter in length. More importantly, while the port-side pod of the bomber carried ordnance, that of the boarding craft was designed to carry passengers (six seated and four standing, using ceiling- and wall-mounted handgrips to keep their balance). In addition to a retractable boarding ramp, the front of the portside pod featured a large, also retractable docking claw with a military-grade [[laser cutter]], which allowed the crew to breach and rush into a captured or disabled vessel. The starboard pod featured a [[transparisteel]] [[viewport]] and housed the [[cockpit]], which was manned by a single [[pilot]]. Like the port-side pod, it could hold ten passengers.<ref name="TIE OWM" /> The elongated wings provided power to the upgraded lift support systems.<ref name="DRVG">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

Equipped with [[P-s4 ion engine|P-s4 twin ion engines]], the TIE boarding craft had a maximum speed of 850 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] in [[atmosphere]], and of 90 [[Megalight per hour|megalights per hour]] in [[Realspace|space]]. Its maximum acceleration amounted to 2,380 [[G (unit)|G]].<ref name="TIE OWM" />

The TIE boarding craft was well-armed. In addition to a pair of [[L-s1 laser cannon]]s and a pair of [[H-s1 heavy laser cannon]]s, it boasted missile and warhead launchers with various munitions. The pilot could count on a [[T-s8 targeting computer]] to help them target those weapons.<ref name="TIE OWM" />

Although it did not feature a [[hyperdrive]], the TIE boarding craft was equipped with an [[N-s4 Navcon]] [[navigation computer]], an [[ejector seat]], a [[life support]] system, and could hold consumables for two [[standard day]]s.<ref name="TIE OWM" />

==Role==
The TIE boarding craft was primarily used to [[transport]] up to 20 [[stormtrooper]]s (two [[squad]]s) from an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] to another [[starship]] or [[space station]]. With its laser-cutter and claw, it also allowed its crew and passengers to force their way aboard another ship.<ref name="TIE OWM" />

==History==
After approving the TIE/sa bomber, the [[Imperial Navy|Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] commissioned [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] to create an armored shuttle. Although Navy officials proposed that Sienar should simply repurpose bombers, the company explained that all the necessary changes would compromise the craft's structural integrity. Nevertheless, they designed a boarding craft that greatly resembled the TIE bomber, in an effort to appease the Navy.<ref name="TIE OWM" />

[[File:TIE_Boarding_Craft_escort-RO.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Two TIE boarding craft and two TIE/ln space superiority starfighters escorting Darth Vader's ''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]
After its introduction, the TIE boarding craft was readily adopted by the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]'s [[Imperial Office of Customs]].<ref name="TIE OWM" /> In [[5 BBY]], a TIE boarding craft was launched from a [[Elk's Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser]] as part of a failed [[Skirmish above Segra Milo|attempt]] to board [[Luthen Rael]]'s [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]], as it was quickly destroyed by said ship.<ref name="DOF">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Vader Immortal – Episode I]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> three of these ships were located in the hangar bay of [[Fortress Vader]].<ref name="VI">{{VaderImmortal|I}}</ref> At the conclusion of the [[Battle of Scarif]], two TIE boarding craft along with two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s escorted [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|shuttle]] to board the [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Profundity]]'' to retrieve the stolen [[Death Star plans]].<ref name="RO" /> Shortly thereafter, in the [[Tatoo system]], Vader used a TIE boarding craft to blast through an airlock of the ''Tantive IV'' and board it.<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]]</ref>

During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], an [[arms dealer]] named [[Korfé Bennux-Ai]] sold old ships,<ref name="TLJ ICS">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> which included at least one TIE boarding craft.<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>
